content:
這個模組包是以 Mine and Slash 模組為基礎打造的 RPG 風格模組包。玩家將進行各種任務、獵殺不斷生成的怪物、刷取裝備，並透過合作或單人挑戰地城來逐步變強。以此獲得的經驗與資源為基礎，逐步打磨出屬於自己特色的構築，最終目標是征服高難度內容「Uber 地圖」。與單純的生存模式不同，本模組包著重於策略性成長與角色養成，提供深度的 RPG 體驗。

This modpack is an RPG-style experience built upon the Mine and Slash mod. Players will embark on diverse quests, hunt down countless monsters, farm powerful gear, and challenge dungeons either solo or in cooperation with others, steadily growing stronger along the way. With the experience and resources gained, they can refine their own unique builds, ultimately aiming to conquer the high-difficulty Uber Maps as the final challenge. Unlike simple survival, this modpack focuses on strategic progression and character development, delivering a deep and immersive RPG experience.

感謝 @Mahjerion  允許我們使用技能樹。
